entities.summary: The Qasim Khanate, also known as the Tsardom of Kasimov, was a Tatar-ruled khanate which existed from 1452 until 1681 on the territory of the Russian state. It was located within modern-day Ryazan Oblast with its capital at Kasimov, in the middle course of the Oka River.
